items.title: Nanopore sequencing combined with adaptive sampling and NanoExpansion enables accurate characterization of repeat expansion disorders.
items.summary: Expansion repeat disorders are caused by abnormal expansions of short tandem repeats (STRs). We evaluated targeted long-read nanopore sequencing for comprehensive characterization of STR expansions in 132 participants, including patients with myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1, n = 51) and DM2 ( n = 3) already characterized by Southern blot, C9orf72 -associated amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS n = 11) evaluated by repeat primed polymerase chain reaction (RP-PCR; validation group), suspected spinocerebellar ataxia (SCA, n = 46), cerebellar ataxia with neuropathy and vestibular areflexia syndrome (CANVAS; n = 13), Huntington's disease (1), Kennedy disease (1), Friedreich ataxia (FRDA, 2), and 4 healthy controls (test group). Native DNA was sequenced using adaptive sampling (AS) on Oxford Nanopore GridION or PromethION-2Solo platforms. Long-PCR sequencing was performed for comparison. We also developed NanoExpansion, a Python-based tool for sizing expanded alleles and detecting sequence interruptions. We correctly characterized all DM1, DM2, ALS, FRDA, Huntington's disease, and Kennedy disease cases, and identified eight SCA27B, two SCA37, three SCA31, one SCA3, and nine CANVAS cases. Compared with the AS approach, long-PCR underestimated alleles exceeding 800 repeats. Repeat interruptions were detected in 27/51 (52.9%) DM1 cases and 1/10 (10%) ALS, but not in CANVAS, FRDA, Huntington's disease, Kennedy disease, or SCA cases. This integrated sequencing analysis pipeline provides accurate, comprehensive characterization of repeat expansion disorders and has the potential to improve routine genetic diagnosis.
items.titleZh: 纳米孔测序结合自适应采样与NanoExpansion实现重复扩增疾病的准确表征
items.summaryZh: 该研究在132名参与者中评估了靶向长读长纳米孔测序（结合自适应采样）对多种短串联重复扩增疾病的检测能力，涵盖DM1/DM2、C9orf72相关ALS、SCA、CANVAS、亨廷顿病、肯尼迪病和FRDA。研究同时开发了NanoExpansion工具用于扩增等位基因 sizing 和序列中断检测。结果显示该方法能正确表征所有DM1、DM2、ALS、FRDA、亨廷顿病和肯尼迪病病例，并识别出多例SCA和CANVAS；长PCR在超过800个重复时存在低估。重复中断在部分DM1和ALS病例中被检出。
items.insight: 该研究为C9orf72等重复扩增相关ALS的基因检测提供了长读长纳米孔测序的整合分析方案，可同时评估扩增大小和序列中断，有助于克服传统PCR和Southern blot在超大扩增检测中的局限，对ALS遗传诊断流程的改进具有直接参考价值。

aiRead.studyType: 观察性临床方法学验证研究
aiRead.keyFinding: 纳米孔自适应采样测序结合NanoExpansion工具可准确表征多种重复扩增疾病，包括C9orf72相关ALS，并检测重复中断；长PCR在超过800个重复时低估扩增大小。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量有限，ALS验证组仅11例，且为方法学比较研究，尚未在常规诊断流程中前瞻性验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该流程在更大规模ALS队列中的验证、成本与周转时间优化，以及能否将重复中断信息纳入C9orf72相关ALS的基因型-表型关联分析。

items.abstractZh: 重复扩增疾病由短串联重复序列（STR）的异常扩增引起。我们评估了靶向长读长纳米孔测序在132名参与者中对STR扩增进行全面表征的能力，包括已通过Southern blot确诊的强直性肌营养不良1型（DM1，n=51）和2型（DM2，n=3）患者、经重复引物PCR（RP-PCR）评估的C9orf72相关肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS，n=11；验证组）、疑似脊髓小脑共济失调（SCA，n=46）、小脑性共济失调伴神经病和前庭反射消失综合征（CANVAS；n=13）、亨廷顿病（1例）、肯尼迪病（1例）、弗里德赖希共济失调（FRDA，2例）以及4名健康对照（测试组）。使用Oxford Nanopore GridION或PromethION-2Solo平台对天然DNA进行自适应采样（AS）测序。同时进行长PCR测序以作比较。我们还开发了NanoExpansion，一个基于Python的工具，用于确定扩增等位基因的大小并检测序列中断。我们正确表征了所有DM1、DM2、ALS、FRDA、亨廷顿病和肯尼迪病病例，并识别出8例SCA27B、2例SCA37、3例SCA31、1例SCA3和9例CANVAS病例。与AS方法相比，长PCR低估了超过800个重复的等位基因。在27/51（52.9%）的DM1病例和1/10（10%）的ALS病例中检测到重复中断，但在CANVAS、FRDA、亨廷顿病、肯尼迪病或SCA病例中未检测到。这一整合测序分析流程可对重复扩增疾病进行准确、全面的表征，并有望改善常规遗传诊断。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究将纳米孔自适应采样与自研分析工具结合，新近展示了长读长测序在C9orf72相关ALS等重复扩增疾病中实现更准确基因分型的转化潜力。

items.title: Enzymatic N-deacylation is the predicted membrane-disruption switch for sphingomyelin: a falsifiable in-silico framework for sphingolipid vulnerability in ALS.
items.summary: Sphingolipid dysregulation is an emerging feature of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), but no systematic method separates species that may worsen axon-myelin membrane integrity from matter that may counteract it. We present an in-silico framework classifying sphingolipids and designed derivatives as candidate membrane-disruptive or candidate protective species, scored against real biological referents using externally published tools rather than a bespoke composite. Its central finding concerns a single, chemically defined difference in lipid state. In coarse-grained (MARTINI 3) molecular dynamics with three independent replicates per system, intact palmitoyl-sphingomyelin is indistinguishable from a pure-POPC bilayer (leaflet-mean Δ thickness + 0.001 nm, 95% CI brackets zero), whereas the modeled N-deacylated form thins it in every replicate (Δ=-0.043 nm, [- 0.046, - 0.041]), tracking a lyso-phosphatidylcholine detergent control (-0.083 nm, [- 0.087, - 0.080]) on two concordant estimators. Because only one lyso-sphingolipid is parameterized in public MARTINI 3, N-deacylation is not established here as a class-wide effect. Across eleven ALS studies (2021-2026), six report elevated serine-palmitoyltransferase (SPT) pathway sphingolipids, all in monogenic SPTLC1/SPTLC2 cohorts, whereas sporadic cohorts show disturbance without a shared direction. Because the simulations do not address whether this species is produced, accumulates, or reaches pathological concentrations in ALS tissue, we present the ALS connection as hypothesis-generating rather than direct evidence. Separately, an explicitly exploratory arm reports two designed modulators with predicted target engagement (Boltz-2) and an ADMET triage of their liabilities. The primary contribution is the membrane result with a wet-lab panel that makes it falsifiable.

items.titleZh: 酶促N-脱酰化是鞘磷脂膜破坏的预测开关：一个用于ALS鞘脂脆弱性的可证伪计算机框架
items.summaryZh: 该研究用计算机模拟（MARTINI 3粗粒化分子动力学）比较完整鞘磷脂与N-脱酰化鞘磷脂对膜厚度的影响，发现后者使膜变薄，类似溶血磷脂酰胆碱的去垢效应；同时系统梳理2021-2026年ALS鞘脂研究，发现SPT通路鞘脂升高仅见于单基因SPTLC1/SPTLC2队列，散发性ALS无一致方向。作者强调这是假设生成性工作，并提出湿实验验证方案。
items.insight: 为ALS鞘脂代谢研究提供了一个可证伪的膜生物物理学假说：N-脱酰化鞘脂可能通过膜破坏参与ALS，且明确区分了单基因与散发性ALS的证据差异，有助于设计后续脂质组学与功能验证实验。

aiRead.keyFinding: N-脱酰化鞘磷脂在模拟中使膜变薄，而完整鞘磷脂不影响膜厚度；ALS中SPT通路鞘脂升高仅见于单基因SPTLC1/SPTLC2队列。
aiRead.limitation: 模拟未验证该脂质种类在ALS组织中是否产生或积累；仅一种溶血鞘脂在MARTINI 3中参数化，不能推广为全类效应；ALS关联为假设生成性。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续湿实验验证N-脱酰化鞘磷脂在ALS模型中的膜破坏作用，以及单基因与散发性ALS鞘脂谱的差异。

items.abstractZh: 鞘脂失调是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的一个新兴特征，但尚无系统方法将可能恶化轴突-髓鞘膜完整性的脂质种类与可能起对抗作用的物质区分开来。我们提出一个计算机框架，将鞘脂及设计衍生物分类为候选膜破坏性或候选保护性种类，并使用外部已发表的工具而非定制的复合评分，对照真实生物学参照物进行评分。其核心发现涉及脂质状态中一个化学上明确的单一差异。在粗粒化（MARTINI 3）分子动力学模拟中，每个系统三个独立重复，完整的棕榈酰-鞘磷脂与纯POPC双分子层无法区分（小叶平均厚度变化 +0.001 nm，95% CI包含零），而建模的N-脱酰化形式在每个重复中均使其变薄（Δ=-0.043 nm，[-0.046, -0.041]），在两个一致估计量上追随溶血磷脂酰胆碱去垢剂对照（-0.083 nm，[-0.087, -0.080]）。由于公共MARTINI 3中仅有一种溶血鞘脂被参数化，N-脱酰化在此并未被确立为全类效应。在十一项ALS研究（2021-2026）中，六项报告丝氨酸棕榈酰转移酶（SPT）通路鞘脂升高，均来自单基因SPTLC1/SPTLC2队列，而散发性队列显示紊乱但无共同方向。由于模拟未涉及该种类在ALS组织中是否产生、积累或达到病理浓度，我们将ALS关联作为假设生成而非直接证据呈现。另外，一个明确探索性分支报告了两种设计调节剂具有预测的靶点结合（Boltz-2）及其 liability 的ADMET筛选。主要贡献是膜结果及使其可证伪的湿实验面板。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近提出可证伪的计算机框架，将鞘脂N-脱酰化与ALS膜完整性脆弱性直接关联，并给出湿实验验证路径，具有机制转化价值。

items.title: Acidic cannabinoids in brain disorders: Neurobiological mechanisms, preclinical evidence, and translational challenges.
items.summary: Acidic cannabinoids, including tetrahydrocannabinolic acid (THCA), cannabidiolic acid (CBDA), cannabigerolic acid (CBGA), and related biosynthetic precursors, represent the predominant phytocannabinoid forms naturally produced by Cannabis sativa. Long considered pharmacologically inactive intermediates, these compounds are now increasingly recognized as bioactive molecules with potential therapeutic relevance for brain disorders. Compared with their decarboxylated counterparts, acidic cannabinoids exhibit distinct physicochemical, pharmacokinetic, and pharmacodynamic properties that may confer reduced psychotropic liability together with unique neurobiological effects. Emerging preclinical evidence indicates that acidic cannabinoids modulate multiple processes implicated in neurological and psychiatric disorders, including serotonergic and endocannabinoid signaling, neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, calcium dyshomeostasis, and synaptic transmission. In this review, we critically examine current knowledge regarding acidic cannabinoids in the context of brain disorders. We first summarize their biosynthesis, chemical stability, pharmacokinetic characteristics, and pharmacological differences from neutral cannabinoids. We then examine preclinical evidence supporting their potential therapeutic effects in epilepsy, anxiety, depression, psychosis-related conditions, and neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. We also discuss how artificial intelligence and computational approaches may support target identification, formulation optimization, pharmacokinetic modeling, and the development of personalized cannabinoid-based interventions. Finally, we highlight key methodological and translational challenges limiting the field and outline priorities for future research. Overall, acidic cannabinoids emerge as promising but still underexplored multitarget compounds with potential relevance for the treatment of brain disorders.

items.titleZh: 酸性大麻素类化合物在脑部疾病中的作用：神经生物学机制、临床前证据与转化挑战
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理酸性大麻素（THCA、CBDA、CBGA等）的生物学特征与脑部疾病相关临床前证据。文章指出这类化合物并非无活性的中间体，而具有多靶点神经生物学作用，涉及5-羟色胺与内源性大麻素信号、神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能、钙稳态和突触传递。文中将肌萎缩侧索硬化列入所讨论的神经退行性疾病范围，但相关证据来自临床前研究，尚未在患者中确立疗效。文章还讨论了人工智能在靶点识别、制剂优化和药代动力学建模中的潜在作用，并强调该领域存在方法学和转化方面的瓶颈。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，本文的价值在于把酸性大麻素作为一类多靶点候选分子纳入神经退行性疾病的研究框架，并明确其与神经炎症、线粒体功能障碍和钙稳态等ALS相关病理过程的交集。同时，文章对药代动力学差异和转化挑战的梳理，有助于判断这类化合物是否值得进入ALS模型验证或早期临床开发，避免将临床前信号误读为临床疗效。

aiRead.keyFinding: 酸性大麻素类化合物具有多靶点神经生物学活性，临床前证据提示其可能调节神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能和钙稳态等过程，并与包括ALS在内的神经退行性疾病相关；但尚无临床疗效证据。

aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否出现针对ALS模型的酸性大麻素干预研究、标准化药代动力学与制剂研究，以及任何早期人体试验登记。

items.abstractZh: 酸性大麻素类化合物，包括四氢大麻酚酸（THCA）、大麻二酚酸（CBDA）、大麻萜酚酸（CBGA）及相关生物合成前体，是Cannabis sativa天然产生的主要植物大麻素形式。这些化合物长期被视为药理学上无活性的中间体，如今日益被认为是对脑部疾病具有潜在治疗相关性的生物活性分子。与其脱羧对应物相比，酸性大麻素类化合物具有独特的理化、药代动力学和药效学特性，可能带来较低的精神活性风险以及独特的神经生物学效应。新兴的临床前证据表明，酸性大麻素类化合物可调节与神经和精神疾病相关的多种过程，包括5-羟色胺能信号传导、内源性大麻素信号传导、神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍、钙稳态失衡以及突触传递。在本综述中，我们批判性地审视了关于酸性大麻素类化合物在脑部疾病背景下的当前知识。我们首先总结其生物合成、化学稳定性、药代动力学特征以及与中性大麻素类化合物的药理学差异。随后，我们审视支持其在癫痫、焦虑、抑郁、精神病相关状况以及神经退行性疾病（包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化）中潜在治疗效果的临床前证据。我们还讨论了人工智能和计算方法如何支持靶点识别、制剂优化、药代动力学建模以及个性化大麻素类干预措施的开发。最后，我们强调了限制该领域的关键方法学和转化挑战，并概述了未来研究的优先事项。总体而言，酸性大麻素类化合物作为有前景但仍未被充分探索的多靶点化合物出现，对脑部疾病的治疗具有潜在相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了酸性大麻素在神经退行性疾病（包括ALS）中的临床前机制证据，并讨论AI辅助的靶点与制剂开发，具有潜在的转化参考价值。

items.title: Global epidemiological and genetic burden of rare neurological diseases in children.
items.summary: We assessed the global burden of rare childhood neurological diseases from 1990 to 2021 and projected trends to 2050 using Global Burden of Disease data, alongside an analysis of the genetic burden from ClinVar. Four neurological conditions were classified as rare childhood neurological diseases: motor neuron disease, multiple sclerosis, neuroblastoma and other peripheral nervous cell tumors, and other neurological disorders. From 1990 to 2021, the global age-standardized prevalence and disability-adjusted life-year rates of rare childhood neurological diseases increased, with higher burdens among boys and in low-middle sociodemographic index countries. Our customized forecasting model projected that 110.2 thousand children would be affected by 2050, representing an 11.83% increase from 2021. Annual and cumulative increases in newly reported disease-causing genes and pathogenic/likely pathogenic variants associated with monogenic neurological diseases were observed from 1990 to 2024. The increasing and disparate burden of rare childhood neurological diseases highlights the need for targeted prevention.
items.evidenceLevel: 流行病学与遗传数据库分析（GBD数据+ClinVar），非动物/细胞实验
items.titleZh: 全球儿童罕见神经系统疾病的流行病学与遗传负担
items.summaryZh: 该研究基于全球疾病负担数据，分析1990—2021年儿童罕见神经系统疾病（含运动神经元病）的患病与伤残负担，并预测至2050年受累儿童将达11.02万，较2021年增加约11.8%。负担在男孩和中低社会人口指数国家更高。研究还利用ClinVar显示，单基因神经系统疾病的致病基因和致病变异报告数量持续累积增加。
items.insight: 运动神经元病被纳入儿童罕见神经系统疾病范畴，提示ALS领域需关注儿童及遗传性运动神经元病的全球流行病学趋势；同时，ClinVar中单基因致病基因与变异的持续增长，为ALS遗传诊断和基因分层研究提供了负担层面的背景依据。

aiRead.studyType: 全球流行病学与遗传数据库分析（GBD 1990—2021及2050预测；ClinVar 1990—2024）
aiRead.keyFinding: 儿童罕见神经系统疾病（含运动神经元病）年龄标化患病率和DALY率上升，2050年预计11.02万儿童受累；单基因神经系统疾病致病基因及致病变异报告持续增加。
aiRead.limitation: 基于GBD和ClinVar的二次数据分析，疾病分类较宽泛，运动神经元病未单独细分儿童与成人，预测模型依赖既有假设，不能直接推断因果关系或临床疗效。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否按疾病亚型（尤其儿童运动神经元病）细分负担，以及遗传变异积累对ALS基因筛查和遗传咨询策略的影响。

items.abstractZh: 我们利用全球疾病负担数据评估了1990年至2021年全球儿童罕见神经系统疾病的负担，并预测了至2050年的趋势，同时分析了ClinVar中的遗传负担。四种神经系统疾病被归类为儿童罕见神经系统疾病：运动神经元病、多发性硬化、神经母细胞瘤及其他外周神经细胞肿瘤，以及其他神经系统疾病。1990年至2021年间，全球儿童罕见神经系统疾病的年龄标化患病率和伤残调整生命年率均上升，男孩及中低社会人口指数国家的负担更高。我们的定制预测模型预计，到2050年将有11.02万名儿童受累，较2021年增加11.83%。1990年至2024年间，与单基因神经系统疾病相关的新报告致病基因及致病/可能致病变异在年度和累计数量上均呈增长趋势。儿童罕见神经系统疾病负担不断上升且存在差异，凸显了针对性预防的必要性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究整合最新全球疾病负担数据与ClinVar遗传变异数据，预测至2050年儿童罕见神经系统疾病（含运动神经元病）负担上升，对ALS相关遗传性运动神经元病的防控与基因筛查具有新近的转化参考价值。

items.title: Biomarker-Guided Diagnosis of Riboflavin Transporter Deficiency Presenting as Seronegative Myasthenia Gravis: A Short Report from a Consanguineous Family.
items.summary: Brown-Vialetto-Van Laere syndrome (BVVLS) is a rare, treatable neurodegenerative disorder caused by riboflavin transporter gene variants (SLC52A2, SLC52A3). Early symptoms can mimic neuromuscular junction disorders, causing diagnostic delays. A 3.5-year-old girl from consanguineous parents presented at 2.5 years with isolated bilateral ptosis, later developing dysphagia, dysphonia, facial diplegia, stridor, and respiratory compromise. Examination revealed tongue atrophy with fasciculations and bulbar weakness but normal limb strength. Diagnosed with seronegative myasthenia gravis, she failed to respond to corticosteroids, pyridostigmine, salbutamol, and intravenous immunoglobulin. Absence of fatigability, lower motor neuron signs, and a sibling history of hearing loss and bulbar palsy prompted genetic testing revealed a homozygous missense variant in SLC52A3 (c.670T > C; p.Phe224Leu). High-dose riboflavin (up to 50 mg/kg/day) led to gradual improvement in bulbar function, resolution of stridor, and respiratory stabilization, though ptosis and tongue fasciculations persisted. This report is novel in using clinical response to riboflavin as a functional biomarker for riboflavin transporter deficiency (RTD) in a patient with a variant of uncertain significance, unlike prior cases with definitive genetics. Empiric riboflavin challenge offers a practical framework when genetic results are ambiguous. RTD should be suspected in children with treatment-resistant, non-fluctuating ptosis and bulbar weakness, particularly with consanguinity or family history of hearing loss and bulbar palsy. Early high-dose riboflavin prevents decline, while immunosuppression is ineffective and potentially harmful.

items.titleZh: 生物标志物引导诊断表现为血清阴性重症肌无力的核黄素转运体缺乏症：一个近亲婚配家庭的简短报告
items.summaryZh: 本报告描述一名近亲婚配家庭的3.5岁女孩，以孤立性双侧上睑下垂起病，逐渐出现吞咽困难、发声困难、双侧面瘫、喘鸣和呼吸受损，伴舌萎缩和肌束颤动，肢体肌力正常。初期按血清阴性重症肌无力治疗无效。因无疲劳性、存在下运动神经元体征及同胞有听力损失和延髓性麻痹史，基因检测发现SLC52A3纯合错义变异（c.670T>C；p.Phe224Leu）。大剂量核黄素（最高50 mg/kg/天）治疗后延髓功能改善、喘鸣消失、呼吸稳定，但上睑下垂和舌肌束颤动持续。作者提出，在遗传结果不明确时，经验性核黄素激发试验可作为RTD的功能性生物标志物；对治疗抵抗、非波动性上睑下垂和延髓肌无力的儿童应警惕RTD，早期大剂量核黄素可防止恶化，免疫抑制无效且可能有害。
items.insight: 该报告提示，在ALS及相关运动神经元病鉴别诊断中，对于表现为延髓肌无力、舌肌束颤动、上睑下垂且对免疫治疗无反应的儿童，应尽早考虑核黄素转运体缺乏症这一可治疗疾病；其提出的“核黄素激发试验作为功能性生物标志物”思路，对意义未明变异的临床决策具有借鉴意义，也提醒避免误用免疫抑制。

items.abstractZh: Brown-Vialetto-Van Laere综合征（BVVLS）是一种罕见的、可治疗的神经退行性疾病，由核黄素转运体基因变异（SLC52A2、SLC52A3）引起。早期症状可模仿神经肌肉接头疾病，导致诊断延迟。一名来自近亲婚配家庭的3.5岁女孩在2.5岁时表现为孤立性双侧上睑下垂，随后出现吞咽困难、发声困难、双侧面瘫、喘鸣和呼吸功能受损。检查发现舌萎缩伴肌束颤动和延髓肌无力，但肢体肌力正常。被诊断为血清阴性重症肌无力，对皮质类固醇、吡啶斯的明、沙丁胺醇和静脉注射免疫球蛋白均无反应。无疲劳性、下运动神经元体征以及同胞有听力损失和延髓性麻痹病史促使进行基因检测，发现SLC52A3纯合错义变异（c.670T > C；p.Phe224Leu）。大剂量核黄素（高达50 mg/kg/天）使延髓功能逐渐改善，喘鸣消失，呼吸稳定，但上睑下垂和舌肌束颤动持续存在。本报告的新颖之处在于，对于一例携带意义未明变异的患者，利用对核黄素的临床反应作为核黄素转运体缺乏症（RTD）的功能性生物标志物，这与先前具有明确遗传学证据的病例不同。当遗传结果不明确时，经验性核黄素激发试验提供了一个实用的框架。对于治疗抵抗、非波动性上睑下垂和延髓肌无力的儿童，尤其是近亲婚配或有听力损失和延髓性麻痹家族史者，应怀疑RTD。早期大剂量核黄素可防止病情恶化，而免疫抑制无效且可能有害。
items.frontierRationale: 新近发表的单例报告提出以核黄素激发试验作为意义未明变异患者的功能性生物标志物，对ALS相关延髓起病表型的可治疗病因鉴别具有转化价值。

items.title: An integrative transcriptomic atlas of ALS and aging skeletal muscle defines shared and distinct molecular programs of degeneration.
items.summary: Skeletal muscle atrophy and weakness resulting from loss of motor neuron innervation are shared hallmarks of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and age-associated sarcopenia. However, muscle wasting in ALS is rapid and severe, whereas sarcopenia progresses gradually over decades, peaking at an advanced age. The molecular mechanisms underlying muscle wasting in these conditions remain incompletely defined. Here, we used the SOD1 G93A ALS mouse model and wild-type mice across the lifespan to generate an integrated single-nucleus transcriptomic atlas of skeletal muscle, mapping changes associated with ALS and aging. This atlas is complemented by structural and functional analyses. Our results identify transcriptionally distinct condition-specific myonuclear states, including disease-responsive programs within synaptic myonuclei at the neuromuscular junction, that are shared or distinct between the two conditions. Notably, at early stages, muscle from ALS mice exhibits molecular hallmarks of aged muscle at the myofiber level, indicating premature aging and reinforcing aging as a risk factor in ALS. At advanced disease stages and in old age, myonuclear subpopulations follow similar degenerative pathways in fast glycolytic fibers, consistent with their loss in both conditions. However, a distinct ALS-enriched myonuclei subpopulation displays uniquely regulated genes not observed in aged muscle, potentially underlying the more rapid and severe pathology observed in ALS. This atlas maps shared and divergent mechanisms of muscle degeneration in ALS and sarcopenia and provides a resource for identifying therapeutic targets tailored to each condition.
items.titleZh: ALS与衰老骨骼肌的整合转录组图谱界定退变的共享与独特分子程序
items.summaryZh: 该研究构建了SOD1 G93A ALS小鼠与野生型小鼠全生命周期的骨骼肌单核转录组图谱，并结合结构与功能分析。研究发现ALS与衰老肌肉存在共享的退变程序，但ALS早期肌肉已出现衰老样分子特征，提示早衰现象；晚期及老年阶段快速糖酵解纤维的肌核亚群走相似退变通路；同时存在一个ALS特有的肌核亚群，其基因调控模式不见于衰老肌肉，可能解释ALS肌肉消耗更快更严重。
items.insight: 这项研究把ALS肌肉病理与衰老肌肉退变放在同一单核转录组框架下比较，区分了共享与ALS特异的肌核状态，为理解ALS中肌肉自主性变化、神经肌肉接头突触肌核的疾病响应以及为何ALS肌肉消耗远快于肌少症提供了资源。对ALS研究者而言，它提示肌肉侧的治疗靶点需区分“衰老样”与“ALS特有”程序，并可作为后续验证肌肉靶点的参考图谱。

items.abstractZh: 由运动神经元支配丧失导致的骨骼肌萎缩和无力是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）与年龄相关肌少症的共同标志。然而，ALS中的肌肉消耗迅速且严重，而肌少症在数十年间逐渐进展，并在高龄时达到高峰。这些情况下肌肉消耗的分子机制仍未完全明确。在此，我们使用SOD1 G93A ALS小鼠模型和跨越生命周期的野生型小鼠，构建了骨骼肌的整合单核转录组图谱，绘制了与ALS和衰老相关的变化。该图谱辅以结构和功能分析。我们的结果识别出转录上不同的条件特异性肌核状态，包括神经肌肉接头处突触肌核内的疾病响应程序，这些程序在两种条件之间共享或不同。值得注意的是，在早期阶段，ALS小鼠的肌肉在肌纤维水平表现出衰老肌肉的分子特征，表明存在早衰并强化了衰老作为ALS风险因素的作用。在疾病晚期和老年阶段，快速糖酵解纤维中的肌核亚群遵循相似的退变通路，与它们在这两种条件下的丢失一致。然而，一个独特的ALS富集肌核亚群显示出在衰老肌肉中未观察到的独特调控基因，可能构成ALS中所见更快速、更严重病理的基础。该图谱绘制了ALS和肌少症中肌肉退变的共享和分歧机制，并为识别针对每种情况定制的治疗靶点提供了资源。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，利用单核转录组图谱新近解析了ALS与衰老骨骼肌的共享及独特退变程序，具有区分ALS特异肌肉病理并指导转化靶点识别的价值。

items.title: Mapping care interventions for people living with motor neurone disease: a living evidence and gap map.
items.summary: Motor neurone disease (MND) is a debilitating, life-limiting neurodegenerative disease that has no cure. Caring for a person living with MND requires a multidisciplinary team delivering interventions to address symptoms. We aimed to map evidence supporting care of those living with MND. Evidence and gap maps (EGMs) were developed according to Campbell and JBI guidance for scoping reviews. Databases searched included CENTRAL, MEDLINE, EMBASE, and PsycINFO with no date restriction. Articles describing care interventions for people living with MND, carers, asymptomatic genetic carriers, family, friends, and healthcare professionals were included. 2390 reports were drawn from 1594 articles that were included across five EGMs, supportive and symptom management ( n = 673 articles), pharmacological ( n = 592), models of care ( n = 196), medical and clinical interventions ( n = 185), and technology and equipment ( n = 91). Interventions primarily addressed people who are living with MND ( n = 1732). No articles were identified specifically concerning First Nations Peoples, Culturally and Linguistically Diverse Peoples, or those living in remote, rural or regional areas. MND care interventions are diverse. Further research is needed to understand options for Culturally and Linguistically Diverse Peoples, First Nations Peoples, and those living in rural, regional, and remote communities.

items.titleZh: 运动神经元病患者照护干预措施图谱：一项动态证据与差距地图
items.summaryZh: 该研究构建了运动神经元病照护干预的动态证据与差距地图，覆盖支持性与症状管理、药物、照护模式、医疗与临床干预、技术与设备五大领域，共纳入1594篇文章。干预措施主要面向MND患者本人，而在原住民、文化和语言多样化人群及农村/偏远地区人群方面存在明显证据空白。

items.abstractZh: 运动神经元病（MND）是一种致残性、限制寿命的神经退行性疾病，目前无法治愈。照护MND患者需要多学科团队提供干预措施以应对症状。我们旨在绘制支持MND患者照护的证据图谱。证据与差距地图（EGM）依据Campbell和JBI范围综述指南制定。检索数据库包括CENTRAL、MEDLINE、EMBASE和PsycINFO，无日期限制。纳入描述针对MND患者、照护者、无症状基因携带者、家人、朋友和医疗专业人员的照护干预措施的文章。从1594篇文章中提取了2390份报告，纳入五个EGM：支持性与症状管理（n=673篇文章）、药物（n=592）、照护模式（n=196）、医疗与临床干预（n=185）、技术与设备（n=91）。干预措施主要针对MND患者（n=1732）。未发现专门涉及原住民、文化和语言多样化人群或居住在偏远、农村或区域地区人群的文章。MND照护干预措施多样。需要进一步研究以了解文化和语言多样化人群、原住民以及居住在农村、区域和偏远社区人群的选择。
items.frontierRationale: 该动态证据地图新近系统整合了MND照护干预证据并揭示文化与地理公平性差距，对ALS照护研究和转化具有参考价值。

items.title: Cryo-EM advances in TDP-43 amyloid fibrils structure determination.
items.summary: TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) is a DNA/RNA-binding protein whose pathological aggregation characterizes a spectrum of neurodegenerative disorders known as TDP-43 proteinopathies, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD), and chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE). Recent breakthroughs in cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) have revolutionized our understanding of these diseases by resolving the atomic structures of TDP-43 amyloid fibrils. These structural insights have been pivotal in elucidating the transition from functional liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) to irreversible solid-state aggregation. This review synthesizes key cryo-EM findings from 2019 to 2026, encompassing fibrils formed by the full-length low-complexity domain, disease-relevant core fragments, and filaments extracted directly from patient tissues, as well as the pathological implications of distinct structural polymorphs. These findings not only deepen our understanding of the brain science aspects of the pathogenesis of TDP-43 proteinopathies, but also provide an important structural basis for the development of specific conformational diagnostic methods and targeted therapeutic drugs.
items.titleZh: 冷冻电镜在TDP-43淀粉样纤维结构解析中的进展
items.summaryZh: 该综述汇总2019至2026年冷冻电镜解析TDP-43淀粉样纤维原子结构的研究，涵盖全长低复杂度结构域纤维、疾病相关核心片段及患者组织提取细丝，并讨论不同结构多晶型的病理意义。文章指出这些结构信息有助于理解TDP-43从液-液相分离到不可逆固态聚集的转变，并为构象特异性诊断和靶向药物开发提供结构基础。
items.insight: TDP-43蛋白病是ALS的核心病理类型之一，冷冻电镜提供的原子级纤维结构正在把“TDP-43聚集”从概念推向可操作的结构靶点。对ALS研究者而言，这篇综述有助于跟踪不同疾病来源纤维的结构多晶型如何与临床表型、诊断标志物和药物设计衔接，是连接基础结构生物学与转化研究的重要参考。

items.abstractZh: TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）是一种DNA/RNA结合蛋白，其病理性聚集是包括肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）、额颞叶变性（FTLD）和慢性创伤性脑病（CTE）在内的一系列被称为TDP-43蛋白病的神经退行性疾病的特征。近年来冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）的突破通过解析TDP-43淀粉样纤维的原子结构，彻底改变了我们对这些疾病的理解。这些结构见解对于阐明从功能性液-液相分离（LLPS）向不可逆固态聚集的转变具有关键作用。本综述综合了2019年至2026年的关键冷冻电镜发现，涵盖由全长低复杂度结构域形成的纤维、疾病相关核心片段、以及直接从患者组织提取的细丝，并讨论了不同结构多晶型的病理学意义。这些发现不仅加深了我们对TDP-43蛋白病发病机制中脑科学方面的理解，也为开发特异性构象诊断方法和靶向治疗药物提供了重要的结构基础。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述整合2019至2026年冷冻电镜新近结构数据，直接关联ALS相关TDP-43蛋白病的构象诊断与靶向治疗转化方向。

items.title: Peripheral and cerebrospinal fluid inflammatory markers in sporadic amyotrophic lateral sclerosis an exploratory cross-sectional association study.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder with an ambiguous etiology, whose onset may be linked to innate immune system activation outside the central nervous system (CNS). We investigated the association between peripheral blood and CNS inflammatory parameters in 45 sporadic ALS patients compared to 30 controls, analyzing peripheral blood tests (C-reactive protein [CRP], blood count, fibrinogen) and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) immunological measures (Tumor Necrosis Factor alpha [TNF-α], TNF receptor type 1 [TNFR-1], CRP) alongside clinical characteristics. Results revealed significantly higher concentrations of TNFR-1 in the CSF of ALS patients compared to the control group (1,029.5 ± 176.0 vs. 846.1 ± 167.5 pg/ml; p < 0.0001). This difference remained significant in multivariable logistic regression adjusting for age and sex (OR 1.82 per 100 pg/ml increment, 95% CI 1.26-2.63; p = 0.0015). In an exploratory ROC analysis, CSF TNFR-1 discriminated patients from controls with an AUC of 0.78 (95% CI 0.67-0.88). TNFR-1 correlated with age (R = 0.32, p = 0.038), associations with disease severity and a lower concentration in bulbar-onset disease were exploratory and not robustly significant. Plasma and CSF CRP concentrations did not differ significantly between groups, but strongly correlated with each other in both ALS (R = 0.83) and control (R = 0.82) cohorts, indicating a disease-non-specific relationship. CSF TNFR-1 is independently associated with sporadic ALS and warrants further investigation as a candidate disease-associated inflammatory biomarker. Given the limitations, our findings do not prove diagnostic accuracy or causality. Longitudinal studies with disease controls and blood-CSF barrier integrity measures are needed.

items.titleZh: 散发性肌萎缩侧索硬化症的外周血和脑脊液炎症标志物：一项探索性横断面关联研究
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究比较了45例散发性ALS患者与30例对照者的外周血和脑脊液炎症指标，发现ALS患者脑脊液中TNFR-1浓度显著升高，且在多变量调整后仍与ALS独立相关，探索性ROC分析显示其区分患者与对照的AUC为0.78。血浆和脑脊液CRP在两组间无差异，但两者高度相关。作者强调该发现不能证明诊断准确性或因果关系，需纵向研究验证。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS的神经炎症机制提供了脑脊液层面的候选标志物线索，TNFR-1作为TNF通路相关指标，可能帮助研究者区分CNS内炎症与外周炎症的贡献。但其横断面设计和缺乏疾病对照限制了临床转化价值，适合作为后续纵向队列和机制研究的假设来源，而非诊断工具的直接证据。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种病因不明的进行性神经退行性疾病，其发病可能与中枢神经系统（CNS）外的先天免疫系统激活有关。我们研究了45例散发性ALS患者与30例对照者外周血和CNS炎症参数之间的关联，分析了外周血检测指标（C反应蛋白[CRP]、血细胞计数、纤维蛋白原）和脑脊液（CSF）免疫学指标（肿瘤坏死因子α[TNF-α]、TNF受体1型[TNFR-1]、CRP）以及临床特征。结果显示，与对照组相比，ALS患者CSF中TNFR-1浓度显著升高（1,029.5 ± 176.0 vs. 846.1 ± 167.5 pg/ml；p < 0.0001）。在调整年龄和性别后的多变量logistic回归中，这一差异仍然显著（每增加100 pg/ml，OR 1.82，95% CI 1.26-2.63；p = 0.0015）。在探索性ROC分析中，CSF TNFR-1区分患者与对照组的AUC为0.78（95% CI 0.67-0.88）。TNFR-1与年龄相关（R = 0.32，p = 0.038），与疾病严重程度的关联以及延髓起病型疾病中浓度较低的发现均为探索性，未达到稳健的统计学显著性。血浆和CSF的CRP浓度在两组间无显著差异，但在ALS组（R = 0.83）和对照组（R = 0.82）中均彼此高度相关，提示这是一种非疾病特异性的关系。CSF TNFR-1与散发性ALS独立相关，值得作为候选的疾病相关炎症生物标志物进一步研究。鉴于研究局限性，我们的发现不能证明诊断准确性或因果关系。需要开展纳入疾病对照并测量血-脑脊液屏障完整性的纵向研究。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近报道了脑脊液TNFR-1与散发性ALS的独立关联，为ALS神经炎症生物标志物研究提供了可跟踪的候选靶点，但尚属探索性观察，转化价值有待纵向验证。

items.title: Salivary Dim-Light Melatonin Onset is Associated with Functional Decline, Respiratory Symptom Emergence, and Survival in Early Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: Sleep-wake and circadian disturbances are increasingly recognized in people living with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (plwALS), but endogenous circadian phase timing and its prognostic significance in early disease remain unclear. We assessed whether salivary dim-light melatonin onset (DLMO), an objective marker of central circadian phase, is altered in early plwALS and whether it provides prognostic information. In this prospective longitudinal observational study, plwALS within 18 months of symptom onset underwent home-based salivary melatonin sampling under dim-light conditions at 6 predefined time points around habitual sleep onset. Melatonin profiles were modeled using cubic smoothing splines, and DLMO was defined when the fitted curve first reached 3 pg/ml. Clinical, respiratory, and sleep assessments were collected at baseline (T0) and after 6 months (T6); a subgroup repeated saliva sampling at T6. Age- and sex-matched controls underwent melatonin profiling. Associations with disease progression, incident respiratory symptoms, and survival/tracheostomy were examined using regressions and survival analyses. A total of 50 plwALS were enrolled. Compared with controls, plwALS showed an earlier DLMO (20:24 ± 1:18 vs 20:58 ± 0:50; p = 0.028) despite similar habitual sleep onset and chronotype. Within ALS cohort, a later baseline DLMO correlated with worse functional/motor status, faster progression of disease, incident dyspnea/orthopnea by T6 (adjusted OR 3.11; p = 0.019), and poorer survival/tracheostomy-free outcome. In the resampled subgroup (n = 28), DLMO and melatonin-derived metrics did not change over ~6 months. Circadian phase alterations are detectable in early ALS. Baseline DLMO showed exploratory associations with functional, respiratory, and survival outcomes. Larger independent cohorts are required before DLMO can be considered a validated prognostic biomarker. ANN NEUROL 2026.
items.titleZh: 唾液暗光褪黑素起始时间与早期肌萎缩侧索硬化功能衰退、呼吸症状出现及生存相关
items.summaryZh: 这项前瞻性纵向观察研究在症状起病18个月内的50例ALS患者中，通过居家暗光唾液褪黑素采样评估中枢昼夜节律相位（DLMO）。结果显示早期ALS患者DLMO较对照者提前，且基线DLMO较晚与更差的功能状态、更快疾病进展、6个月内新发呼吸困难/端坐呼吸及更差的生存/无气管切开结局相关；重复采样亚组中DLMO约6个月内保持稳定。作者强调这些关联为探索性，DLMO尚不能作为经验证的预后生物标志物。
items.insight: 该研究提示昼夜节律相位可能是早期ALS可客观测量的维度，且与呼吸症状出现和生存等关键结局存在探索性关联；若能在独立大队列中验证，DLMO有望成为低成本、居家可采集的预后分层工具，并为节律相关干预的试验设计提供依据。

items.abstractZh: 睡眠-觉醒及昼夜节律紊乱在肌萎缩侧索硬化患者（plwALS）中日益受到关注，但内源性昼夜节律相位时相及其在早期疾病中的预后意义仍不明确。本研究评估唾液暗光褪黑素起始时间（DLMO）——中枢昼夜节律相位的客观标志物——在早期plwALS中是否发生改变，以及其是否提供预后信息。在这项前瞻性纵向观察研究中，症状起病18个月内的plwALS在暗光条件下、围绕习惯性入睡时间6个预设时间点进行居家唾液褪黑素采样。褪黑素曲线采用三次平滑样条建模，DLMO定义为拟合曲线首次达到3 pg/ml的时间。在基线（T0）和6个月后（T6）收集临床、呼吸及睡眠评估；一个亚组在T6重复唾液采样。年龄和性别匹配的对照者接受褪黑素谱检测。采用回归和生存分析检验其与疾病进展、新发呼吸症状及生存/气管切开结局的关联。共纳入50例plwALS。与对照者相比，plwALS的DLMO更早（20:24 ± 1:18 vs 20:58 ± 0:50；p = 0.028），尽管习惯性入睡时间和时型相似。在ALS队列内，基线DLMO较晚与更差的功能/运动状态、更快的疾病进展、T6时新发呼吸困难/端坐呼吸（校正OR 3.11；p = 0.019）以及更差的生存/无气管切开结局相关。在重复采样亚组（n = 28）中，DLMO及褪黑素衍生指标在约6个月内未发生变化。早期ALS中可检测到昼夜节律相位改变。基线DLMO与功能、呼吸及生存结局显示出探索性关联。在DLMO可被视为经过验证的预后生物标志物之前，需要更大规模的独立队列。ANN NEUROL 2026。
items.frontierRationale: 新近发表于Annals of Neurology的前瞻性纵向研究首次在早期ALS中系统评估居家唾液DLMO的预后关联，具有生物标志物转化潜力但尚待独立验证。

items.title: Ataxin-2 downregulation rewires neuronal and astrocytic metabolism to protect against TDP-43 toxicity.
items.summary: Ataxin-2 (ATXN2) is a genetic modifier of TDP-43 toxicity and a promising therapeutic target in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). However, the mechanisms underlying its neuroprotective effects remain poorly understood. Using global proteomic profiling in yeast and mouse TDP-43 models, we establish that pbp1/ataxin-2 (pbp1 is the yeast ataxin-2 ortholog) reduction confers neuroprotection by activating orthogonal stress-adaptive pathways in neurons and glia, rather than simply reversing TDP-43-induced damage. In neurons, ataxin-2 downregulation activates glycolysis and reductive glutamine carboxylation driven by IDH1, restoring ATP production independently of impaired mitochondria. In astrocytes, it upregulates cholesterol biosynthesis via HMGCS1, enhancing trophic support to neurons. Full neuroprotection requires both mechanisms: neuronal survival is only completely rescued when ataxin-2 is reduced in neuron-astrocyte co-cultures. Importantly, ataxin-2 downregulation protects against both TDP-43 gain- and loss-of-function toxicity, broadening its therapeutic relevance. Collectively, these findings establish ataxin-2 as a regulator of stress-adaptive metabolic resilience.

items.title: Interventions to support informal carers managing behavioral symptoms in frontotemporal lobar degeneration: a scoping review.
items.summary: Informal carers of people living with frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD) face significant challenges in managing complex behavioral symptoms, yet disease specific support remains limited. This scoping review explored non-pharmacological interventions developed to support this carer population. Database searches were conducted across Medline, APA PsycINFO, CINAHL, ERIC, E-Journals, and Scopus from January 2011 to November 2025, supplemented by hand searching, identifying nine included studies. Interventions broadly comprised occupational therapy-based activity programmes, psychoeducational approaches, and web-based self-management tools. The majority of studies were feasibility or acceptability studies, with findings generally positive; however, behavioral symptoms were inconsistently reported, and sample sizes were small, highlighting that evidence remains at an early stage. Despite the promising nature of existing approaches, structured implementation of non-pharmacological interventions to support informal carers manage behavioral symtoms into clinical practice remains absent. Translating feasible and acceptable interventions into accessible, disease-specific support for carers of people living with FTLD is urgently needed.

items.title: Registry Forge: an open-source end-to-end pipeline for patient-directed SMART on FHIR registries.
items.summary: Patient-directed SMART on FHIR lets registries acquire longitudinal electronic health record data, but the payload requires substantial engineering before use. We present Registry Forge, an open-source pipeline that converts it into curation-ready outputs. Registry Forge parses C-CDA, HTML, RTF, PDF, and FHIR inputs, joins records to a canonical identifier, and emits a browser dashboard, an OMOP CDM v5.4 data set, GA4GH Phenopackets v2, a code inventory, and disease-specific narrative extractions. Applied to the ALS Research Collaborative Study (94 participants, 56 US health systems), it processed 22 686 files and 1791 FHIR Bundles (109 599 resources); only 15.0% of files were full C-CDA XML; HTML (48.4%) and RTF (34.3%) predominated. Payloads are far more heterogeneous than often assumed; the architecture is designed for extension, though generalizability remains to be demonstrated. Registry Forge closes the gap between acquisition and curation-ready data with no server infrastructure and is openly available.
